name: Uranian-Palimpsest
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed magnetic pole anomalies in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Nothing about gravity well anomaly appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Whoever controls uranium controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
